name: @aske/mobile
description: Android app: the same web app inside a native shell (Capacitor) with background playback and in-app updates.
author: Andoni Ortiz de Zarate Urruela (https://github.com/Ando144)

scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @aske/web && npm run build:android -w @aske/web && node ../../scripts/bundle-worker.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleDebug
